run_indic_normalize_tokenize: run the script to normalize and tokenize Indic language text from a file using the Indic NLP Library
run_indic_normalize_with_nuktas_removal: run the script with --remove-nuktas to normalize Indic text and remove nuktas before tokenizing
run_indic_tokenize_from_stdin: run the script with input set to - to normalize and tokenize Indic text from stdin
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args and normalizes then tokenizes Indic language text line by line
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support batch processing of multiple input files at once
